author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
Peter Jackson recently told Empire magazine that a Mithril Cut of The Lord of the Rings film does not exist and wouldn't be worthwhile doing.  But what instead of a Mithril "Cut" we got a Mithril Edition home media release and a new documentary from PJ himself?!

Empire Article: "Lord Of The Rings ‘Extended-Extended Edition’ Mithril Cut Doesn’t Exist, Says Peter Jackson"
https://www.empireonline.com/movies/news/lord-of-the-rings-extended-extended-edition-mithril-cut-doesnt-exist-peter-jackson/

Check out my chat with TORn Tues: https://www.youtube.com/live/NLMVQsWX7Yw?si=hOj-yYvfNYpwb7LG

My petition from 2021: https://www.change.org/p/warner-brothers-release-the-mithril-edition-of-the-lord-of-the-rings

title: The LOTR Mithril Cut Doesn't Exist...
